AI: Artificial Intelligence — computer systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence.
ML: Machine Learning — a subset of AI that allows systems to learn and improve from experience.
NLP: Natural Language Processing — AI that understands and generates human language.
LLM: Large Language Model — a type of AI model that can generate human-like text.
GPT: Generative Pre-trained Transformer — a type of LLM developed by OpenAI.
API: Application Programming Interface — a set of rules that allows different software applications to communicate.
SaaS: Software as a Service — a software distribution model where applications are hosted by a provider.
Subscription: A recurring payment model where users pay a regular fee to access a service.
Marketplace: A platform where users can purchase digital products and services from third-party providers.
PKR: Pakistan Rupee — the official currency of Pakistan.
JPY: Japanese Yen — the official currency of Japan.
VPN: Virtual Private Network — a service that encrypts internet traffic and hides IP addresses.
SEO: Search Engine Optimization — the practice of improving website visibility in search engines.
GSC: Google Search Console — a free Google tool for monitoring website performance in search results.
GA4: Google Analytics 4 — Google's web analytics platform for tracking user behavior.
